reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 noun questions across 20 pinned B1/B2 source records: inspected complete German sentences, cases and forms, each distractor, unique offered answer, distinct contexts, bilingual instructions/hints/explanations, source meanings and provenance. Existing production and initial/B2/workplace/general-expansion draft objectives inspected; no identical noun-specific objective identified. Source errors and sense distinctions documented in per-row corrections. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review remains pending. After a second full-sentence editorial pass, clarified forced-entry evidence for Einbruch/Einbrecher and replaced an awkward Einfall construction.
